description: Client considering acquisition of smaller competitor Meridian Analytics. Requires business assessment (market impact, operational integration), legal assessment (regulatory compliance, due diligence), and accounting assessment (valuation, tax implications, financial consolidation).

matter.title: Meridian Analytics Acquisition — Strategic Assessment
matter.description: Comprehensive cross-domain assessment of proposed acquisition of Meridian Analytics Inc., a data analytics competitor with $12M annual revenue and 85 employees. Client seeks unified recommendation spanning business strategy, legal compliance, and financial impact.

follow_up_actions.title: Complete financial due diligence
follow_up_actions.description: Review Meridian's audited financials for past 3 fiscal years, assess quality of earnings, and identify any off-balance-sheet liabilities

follow_up_actions.title: Regulatory compliance assessment
follow_up_actions.description: Assess antitrust implications of acquisition given combined market share in data analytics sector. Determine if HSR filing is required.

follow_up_actions.title: Operational integration planning
follow_up_actions.description: Develop preliminary integration plan covering technology stack consolidation, team restructuring, and client migration timeline

follow_up_actions.title: Tax structure optimization
follow_up_actions.description: Evaluate acquisition structure options (asset purchase vs. stock purchase) for tax efficiency. Model Section 338(h)(10) election implications.

follow_up_actions.title: IP and contract review
follow_up_actions.description: Review Meridian's IP portfolio, key customer contracts for change-of-control clauses, and employment agreements for non-compete provisions

notes.content: Initial LOI signed March 15. Exclusivity period runs through June 30, 2026. Client authorized up to $18M for acquisition.
Meridian's largest client (DataTech Corp, 22% of revenue) has a change-of-control clause that allows termination with 90 days notice. This represents $2.64M annual revenue at risk.

areas: Market impact analysis — combined market share and competitive positioning
Operational integration feasibility — technology, team, processes
Client retention risk assessment — particularly DataTech Corp account
Strategic alignment with client's 3-year growth plan
Synergy identification — revenue synergies and cost savings
Antitrust / HSR filing requirements — combined entity market share analysis
Change-of-control clause review across all material contracts
IP portfolio assessment and freedom-to-operate analysis
Employment agreement review — non-competes, retention packages
Regulatory compliance status — data privacy, industry regulations
Representations and warranties for purchase agreement
key_concerns: HSR filing threshold likely exceeded — $111.4M in 2026
3 key customer contracts have change-of-control provisions

areas: Valuation analysis — DCF, comparable transactions, asset-based
Quality of earnings assessment — normalize for one-time items
Tax structure optimization — asset vs. stock purchase
Purchase price allocation — goodwill and intangible assets
